title: yaks kernel keyword vocabulary
description: The three things a graph of work says about its own words that the core meta-model does not: which facets a project governs, which log lines never ride a boot snapshot, and which text column completes out of a named well.

governed.description: true = a durable work or knowledge facet governed by project-rooted edge paths: what a project's reach is computed over.

lazy.description: true = this component never rides a boot snapshot; a reader asks for its rows by the partition they belong to.

well.description: The named well a text column's completions are drawn from, beside the column's own live distinct values. The name is the well's, registered by whoever holds the values — the schema stays declarative.
